 ==== PM2WADDA.H
 
-TODO: Add missing PM2WADDA.H
+===== Encoding
+
+PM2WADDA.H is encoded in a register-pair (rdp) OP-IMM-32 format as an
+accumulating form of PM2WADD.H.
+
+[wavedrom, ,svg]
+....
+{reg:[
+    { bits: 7, name: 0x1b, attr: ['OP-IMM-32'] },
+    { bits: 1, name: 0x1 },
+    { bits: 4, name: 'rdp' },
+    { bits: 3, name: 0x2 },
+    { bits: 5, name: 'rs1' },
+    { bits: 5, name: 'rs2' },
+    { bits: 2, name: 0x3 },
+    { bits: 4, name: 0x1, attr: ['PM2WADDA.H'] },
+    { bits: 1, name: 0x0 },
+]}
+....
+
+===== Operation
+
+[source,pseudocode]
+----
+s1 = X[rs1]
+s2 = X[rs2]
+
+// Read accumulator from register pair; treat as zero when rdp=0
+acc = (rdp == 0) ? 0 : (X[2*rdp+1] @ X[2*rdp])
+
+p0 = to_bits(64, sext_64(s1[15:0])  * sext_64(s2[15:0]))
+p1 = to_bits(64, sext_64(s1[31:16]) * sext_64(s2[31:16]))
+
+acc = acc + p0 + p1
+
+if (rdp != 0):
+    X[2*rdp]   = acc[31:0]
+    X[2*rdp+1] = acc[63:32]
+----
+
+===== Description
+
+PM2WADDA.H multiplies corresponding signed 16-bit halfwords of `rs1` and `rs2`
+(halfword0*halfword0 and halfword1*halfword1), sums the two 64-bit products, and
+accumulates the sum into the 64-bit accumulator held in the destination register
+pair selected by `rdp`.

+===== Encoding
+
+PM2WADDA.HX is encoded in a register-pair (rdp) OP-IMM-32 format as an
+accumulating cross-halfword form of PM2WADD.HX.
+
+[wavedrom, ,svg]
+....
+{reg:[
+    { bits: 7, name: 0x1b, attr: ['OP-IMM-32'] },
+    { bits: 1, name: 0x1 },
+    { bits: 4, name: 'rdp' },
+    { bits: 3, name: 0x2 },
+    { bits: 5, name: 'rs1' },
+    { bits: 5, name: 'rs2' },
+    { bits: 2, name: 0x3 },
+    { bits: 4, name: 0x3, attr: ['PM2WADDA.HX'] },
+    { bits: 1, name: 0x0 },
+]}
+....
+
+===== Operation
+
+[source,pseudocode]
+----
+s1 = X[rs1]
+s2 = X[rs2]
+
+// Read accumulator from register pair; treat as zero when rdp=0
+acc = (rdp == 0) ? 0 : (X[2*rdp+1] @ X[2*rdp])
+
+p0 = to_bits(64, sext_64(s1[15:0])  * sext_64(s2[31:16]))
+p1 = to_bits(64, sext_64(s1[31:16]) * sext_64(s2[15:0]))
+
+acc = acc + p0 + p1
+
+if (rdp != 0):
+    X[2*rdp]   = acc[31:0]
+    X[2*rdp+1] = acc[63:32]
+----
+
+===== Description
+
+PM2WADDA.HX multiplies cross halfword pairs of `rs1` and `rs2` (low halfword of
+`rs1` by high halfword of `rs2`, and high halfword of `rs1` by low halfword of
+`rs2`), both signed, sums the two 64-bit products, and accumulates the sum into
+the 64-bit accumulator held in the destination register pair selected by `rdp`.

+....

+    { bits: 5, name: 'rs2' },
+    { bits: 2, name: 0x3 },
+    { bits: 4, name: 0x9, attr: ['PM2WSUBA.H'] },
+    { bits: 1, name: 0x0 },
+]}
+....
+
+===== Operation
+
+[source,pseudocode]
+----
+s1 = X[rs1]
+s2 = X[rs2]
+
+// Read accumulator from register pair; treat as zero when rdp=0
+acc = (rdp == 0) ? 0 : (X[2*rdp+1] @ X[2*rdp])
+
+p0 = to_bits(64, sext_64(s1[15:0])  * sext_64(s2[15:0]))
+p1 = to_bits(64, sext_64(s1[31:16]) * sext_64(s2[31:16]))
+
+acc = acc + p0 - p1
+
+if (rdp != 0):
+    X[2*rdp]   = acc[31:0]
+    X[2*rdp+1] = acc[63:32]

+
+===== Description
+
+PM2WSUBA.H multiplies corresponding signed 16-bit halfwords of `rs1` and `rs2`,
+computes (low*low) minus (high*high), and accumulates the 64-bit difference into
+the accumulator held in the destination register pair selected by `rdp`.
